# Free Society Hack

> A Zcash hackathon with a Bitrefill track, solo or in teams of up to 4, Mumbai (True Tramm Trunk, BKC), Wed 4 – Thu 5 Nov 2026 (IST, UTC+5:30), during Devcon week. Each track file below is self-contained: load the one you need, or both.

Version: 2026-11-02. These files may be updated during the hack; when the hacker chat announces a new version, re-fetch them.

## Pick your track

- [Privacy track (Zcash)](https://stadium.joinwebzero.com/programs/free-society-hack-2026/privacy/llms.txt): build private money on Zcash. Testnet only, shielded payments, no real money.
- [Agentic Commerce track (Bitrefill)](https://stadium.joinwebzero.com/programs/free-society-hack-2026/agentic-commerce/llms.txt): an agent that finds, buys and pays through Bitrefill on its own. Real purchases with event credits.
- Entering both: load both files and meet both sets of requirements. Testnet TAZ cannot pay Bitrefill; each track file has a "Both tracks" recipe (a shielded testnet payment authorises a purchase paid from event credits).

## Start (paste into your coding agent)

- Privacy: `Read https://stadium.joinwebzero.com/programs/free-society-hack-2026/privacy/llms.txt and save it as AGENTS.md in a new repo. Follow its "First steps" section before writing any product code. If you pick a Rust tool (zkool_graphql, zingo-cli, zcash-devtool), start its build in a second terminal first: it takes 15–30 minutes. Get a utest1 address with an Ironwood receiver, claim TAZ, see one real shielded testnet payment land. Then scaffold the smallest version of my idea.`
- Agentic Commerce: `Read https://stadium.joinwebzero.com/programs/free-society-hack-2026/agentic-commerce/llms.txt and save it as AGENTS.md in a new repo. Follow its "First steps" section: confirm the product IDs and prices with the CLI, write the spend cap, create one unpaid invoice on a zero-balance account. Then scaffold the smallest version of my idea.`
- Both: paste both lines; the agent reads both files and keeps one repo.

Where this file and a track file disagree, the track file wins; where a track file and a mentor disagree, the mentor wins.

## During the hack

- Each track file lists "Stop and ask a mentor" moments. Post the question in the mentors chat and keep building the parts that don't depend on the answer. Mentor hours: 11:00–14:00, 15:00–18:00, 18:00–21:00.
- Both tracks ask for a FEEDBACK.md (what broke, confused or slowed you down). Bitrefill pays $100 for the best one. It is easiest to write from notes kept from the first error onwards.

## Key times (IST)

- Wed 4 Nov 11:00: hacking starts. All code is made at the hack: new repo on the day, judges read the commit history. Ideas, research and sketches from before are fine.
- Wed 4 Nov 20:00: click **Finalize and submit** on Stadium to be in the first Privacy judging session (20:00–22:00). Drafts are saved but not judged. The point person starts the submission with their Luma email and can give teammates edit access; the event feedback form must be submitted before finalizing. A finalized submission stays editable until 00:00.
- Thu 5 Nov 00:00: submissions close. Code after 00:00 isn't scored.
- Thu 5 Nov 08:00–10:00: second judging session.
- Thu 5 Nov 11:00: top teams are contacted.
- Thu 5 Nov 12:00: demos of top teams. Demoing isn't required to win; judges score every submission.
- Thu 5 Nov 13:30: prize announcements.

## Rules for everyone

- Checked-in Luma guests only, solo or a team of up to 4. One point person per project receives any prize.
- Privacy prizes are paid in USDC; Agentic Commerce prizes in Bitrefill gift cards. One hacker also receives a ZKSnarks NFT as the "MVP" prize.
- Demo video: 2–3 minutes; judges watch only the first 3 minutes. Every step shown must be real.
- You agree to the hack terms when you submit on Stadium. Organisers can remove anyone who isn't respectful.

- TAZ (testnet coins): any Zcash mentor can send you some. Event credits for Bitrefill purchases: the Bitrefill team. Free Nym subscription credits: Max Hampshire (Nym), at the venue.
